acceptanceCriteria: MALFORMED discovery results carry a stable reason code and detail for decode, non-canonical encoding and field validation failures.
Focused tests cover each reason; the wire contract change is recorded in the spec.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#709. An indented (non-canonical) or foreign-shaped receipt yields discovery.state=MALFORMED with no diagnostic. Expected: a stable one-line reason distinguishing decode failure, non-canonical bytes and the failing validation field.
title: affected: a MALFORMED playwright-discovery receipt reports no reason (GitHub #709 part 3)
